snippet.description:
​కుక్కర్ రబ్బర్ (గ్యాస్కెట్) లూజ్ అవ్వడం వల్ల విజిల్ సరిగ్గా రాకుండా, చుట్టూ ఆవిరి లేదా నీరు కారిపోతుందా?
​వంట చేయడానికి 10 నుంచి 15 నిమిషాల ముందు ఆ రబ్బర్‌ను డీప్ ఫ్రిజ్ (Freezer) లో పెట్టండి. చల్లదనానికి రబ్బర్ కుంచించుకుపోయి టైట్‌గా మారుతుంది. ఆ తర్వాత మూతకు పెడితే ఆవిరి అస్సలు లీక్ అవ్వదు, విజిల్ పర్ఫెక్ట్‌గా వస్తుంది!
​మీ కిచెన్‌లో బాగా ఉపయోగపడే ఈ స్మార్ట్ హ్యాక్‌ను తప్పకుండా ట్రై చేయండి.
​🔔 మరిన్ని అద్భుతమైన కిచెన్ టిప్స్ మరియు రుచికరమైన వంటల కోసం మా ఛానెల్‌ని Subscribe చేసుకోండి!
​#PressureCookerHacks #KitchenTips #CookingHacks #TeluguVantalu #CookerRepair #SmartKitchen #KitchenTipsInTelugu #CookingShorts #TeluguReels #AromaTeluguFlavours

snippet.description:
The LevelUp IAS GS Foundation Course for UPSC CSE 2028 is designed as an integrated, long-term preparation system for first-time UPSC aspirants, college students and working professionals. The program starts with the basics and takes students to advanced, exam-oriented preparation while integrating Prelims, Mains, and Interview preparation.

Explore GS Foundation 2028: https://shorturl.at/mV69J

The program includes 1000+ hours of GS classes, complete GS Paper 1–4 coverage, Current Affairs Pre-Cum-Mains, Prelims & Mains Test Series, CSAT, Essay, daily answer-writing practice, weekly doubt sessions, dedicated 1-to-1 mentorship, UPSC skill workshops and Interview preparation. Tests are structured across weekly, monthly, quarterly and half-yearly cycles to build continuous revision and assessment.

The broader roadmap covers GS Foundation, Current Affairs, intensive Prelims preparation, Mains preparation and Interview preparation, with dedicated mentorship throughout the journey.

The faculty team includes Santosh Kumar Sir, Nikhil Sheth Sir, G. Babu Sir, Atul Garg Sir, Vivek Singh Sir, Akhilesh Shrivastava Sir, Karandeep Singh Sir, Nishat Singh Sir, Himanshi Ahuja Ma’am, S.N. Chakraborty Sir, Chandan Kumar Sir and Vishal Singh Sir.

The batch is designed for beginners with no prior UPSC knowledge required, making it suitable for aspirants starting their preparation from scratch.

Batch Starts: 5 October 2026

The LevelUp IAS GS Foundation Course for UPSC CSE 2028 is designed as an integrated, long-term preparation system for first-time UPSC aspirants, college students and working professionals. The program starts with the basics and takes students to advanced, exam-oriented preparation while integrating Prelims, Mains, and Interview preparation.

Explore GS Foundation 2028: https://shorturl.at/mV69J

The program includes 1000+ hours of GS classes, complete GS Paper 1–4 coverage, Current Affairs Pre-Cum-Mains, Prelims & Mains Test Series, CSAT, Essay, daily answer-writing practice, weekly doubt sessions, dedicated 1-to-1 mentorship, UPSC skill workshops and Interview preparation. Tests are structured across weekly, monthly, quarterly and half-yearly cycles to build continuous revision and assessment.

The broader roadmap covers GS Foundation, Current Affairs, intensive Prelims preparation, Mains preparation and Interview preparation, with dedicated mentorship throughout the journey.

The faculty team includes Santosh Kumar Sir, Nikhil Sheth Sir, G. Babu Sir, Atul Garg Sir, Vivek Singh Sir, Akhilesh Shrivastava Sir, Karandeep Singh Sir, Nishat Singh Sir, Himanshi Ahuja Ma’am, S.N. Chakraborty Sir, Chandan Kumar Sir and Vishal Singh Sir.

The batch is designed for beginners with no prior UPSC knowledge required, making it suitable for aspirants starting their preparation from scratch.

Batch Starts: 5 October 2026
